reasons: Both recipes validate with zero findings and both runs exited 0 with no failed node; the verify recipe asserts fixed values and the node-for-node identical baseline asserts the buggy values.

The recipe fails if the fix is reverted: ac2-assert-open-total and ac4-assert-home-open-total wait on the -$1.15 summed fee, which only renders once all four fills of order 60252966679 are merged, and ac3-assert-flip-test expects exit 0 where the baseline expects exit 1.

Both mixed ACs carry a before/after screenshot pair that was read and visibly shows one 8.29 SOL open going from four partial rows to one; both state ACs are backed by indexed Jest logs rather than screenshots.

No forbidden pattern is present: no switch, no eval_sync/eval_async/eval_ref, no wait nodes, no UI value injection - the SOL order was placed through the manifest-declared metamask.perps.place_order action.

intent_clarity.reason: Every node intent states the human-visible goal rather than the action or selector, and the structural validator accepts both graphs.
evidence: mm-harness run <recipe> --plan --json returned status pass with findings []
